cards.answer: Kog'Maw is a marksman/mage who combines empowered ranged attacks with long-range artillery. His empowered attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health, while his artillery hits harder against low-health enemies.
cards.counterplay: Limit prolonged trades during his empowered attacks, dodge artillery, and move away from him after he dies.

cards.answer: Living Artillery strikes a distant target location after a delay, dealing magic damage that increases against wounded enemies and is especially strong against low-health targets. cards.counterplay: Keep moving to evade delayed strikes and retreat cautiously when low on health.
